notes_en: At Shichahai-Yuhe, morning: the water gates carry the memory of grain tribute barges. What arrives, what leaves, where transfer occurs, what changes.
notes_zh: 后海—御河,清晨:水闸仍承载着漕运粮船的集体记忆。何来、何去、何处中转、何者改变。
tags: 运河, 粮食, 什刹海

title_en: When the past grows new life
notes_en: Gamla Skogsby, Iron Age site: soil, plants and food are being used to ask whether the past can generate future life.
notes_zh: Gamla Skogsby 铁器时代遗址:以土壤、植物与食物追问——过去能否生长出未来的生命。
tags: 再生, 厄兰岛, 铁器时代

notes_en: Tongzhou, dawn: joggers and yangge troupes move along the Grand Canal park while a museum recreates the 1920s towpath. The canal lives twice - as daily amenity and as displayed heritage.
notes_zh: 通州,拂晓:晨跑者与秧歌队沿着大运河公园移动,博物馆则在重建 1920 年代的纤道。运河被双重活化——既是日常设施,又是被展出的遗产。
tags: 通州, 活态遗产, 博物馆, 日常生活

title_en: Porridge at the old grain wharf
notes_en: Zhangjiawan, the historic tribute-grain wharf: the quay keeps its old alignment while the waterside market opens for breakfast; porridge vendors work the morning crowd where barges once tied up.
notes_zh: 张家湾,漕运古码头:码头仍保持旧时走向,而近水早市已开张;粥摊在当年粮船停靠的人群中营业。
tags: 张家湾, 漕粮, 码头, 早市

notes_en: The Qingcheng lock gate (upper lock) is preserved within the modern city grid; the canal beneath the street map is lined with re-created heritage. Living heritage here is staged between daily life and display.
notes_zh: 澄清上闸被保留在现代城市网格之内;街图之下的运河两岸排列着再造的遗产。此间的活态遗产,在日常生活与展示之间被演出。
tags: 北京大运河, 澄清闸, 遗产化

notes_en: Visby, a loop of the town wall: thirteenth-century ramparts now buffer hotels and tour buses; the wall is kept authentic while the life behind it is re-invented for tourism.
notes_zh: 维斯比,沿城墙环行:十三世纪城墙如今缓冲着酒店与旅游大巴;城墙被保持原真,其背后的生活却在为旅游业被重新发明。
tags: 维斯比, 城墙, 原真性, 旅游

notes_en: Frojel harbour, from which Viking-Age goods once shipped out: the same bay now lands herring sold straight at the quayside; one catch at a time, the food corridor comes ashore.
notes_zh: 弗勒耶尔港,维京时代曾从这里运出货物:如今同一处海湾的鲱鱼在码头边直售;一船一船,食物廊道登岸了。
tags: 里丹纳斯, 鲱鱼, 码头直售, 食物廊道

title_en: From kitchen floor to future grain
notes_en: Gamla Skogsby, on the 2021-season kitchen assemblage: pig bones, quern stones and pottery read as the record of a chieftain household; soil carried out of the floors is being re-sown with heritage cereals.
notes_zh: Gamla Skogsby,就 2021 季厨房遗存而言:猪骨、磨石与陶器被解读为一个首领之家的记录;从灶台下取出的土壤正被重新种上传统谷物。
tags: Gamla Skogsby, 厨房, 宴饮, 再生

notes_en: Nykvarn lock, Lake Roxen: the lock keeper now doubles as guide, freight barges carry day-trippers, and the national-interest designation preserves the 1871 waterway as cultural scenery.
notes_zh: Nykvarn 闸,罗森湖:闸门管理员兼任导游,货驳载着观光客,国家利益保护把这条 1871 年的水道保存为文化风景。
tags: 金达运河, Nykvarn 闸, 国家利益, 旅游

title_en: Ridanäs is not on the tentative list
notes_en: Desk record, 2026-09-11: Sweden's UNESCO Tentative List holds a single entry (The Rise of Systematic Biology, 2009); Ridanäs is absent. The earlier Wikipedia-based claim is dropped and the site description updated.
notes_zh: 档案记录 2026-09-11:瑞典 UNESCO 暂定名录现仅有唯一一项（The Rise of Systematic Biology, 2009）；Ridanäs 不在其中。此前的维基说法已撤销，站点描述已更新。
tags: 档案, 核验, UNESCO, 哥特兰

title_en: Liveness as starting point: Kinda Canal
title_zh: 以「活态」为出发点：金达运河
notes_en: Desk record, 2026-09-11: kindakanal.se confirms the waterway has been an important route since 1871 (15 hand-operated locks, ~80 km); no official 'living heritage' designation exists — liveness here is the project's premise, not a claim about status.
notes_zh: 档案记录 2026-09-11:kindakanal.se 确认此水道自 1871 年起持续作为重要通道（15 座手控船闸、约 80 公里）；不存在官方「活态遗产」认定——此处「活态」是本项目的前提，而非对既有身份的断言。
tags: 档案, 核验, 金达运河, 活态

title_en: Southern Öland boundary includes Gamla Skogsby
title_zh: 南厄兰遗产边界包含 Gamla Skogsby
notes_en: Desk record, 2026-09-11: UNESCO WHC 968 (criterion iv, v) inscribed area 56,286 ha — confirmed that the property runs from Karlevi to Gårdby and southward (2024 46COM 8D clarifications), placing Gamla Skogsby within the heritage area.
notes_zh: 档案记录 2026-09-11:UNESCO WHC 968（准则 iv、v）核定面积 56,286 公顷——已确认遗产范围自 Karlevi 至 Gårdby 并延伸向南（2024 年 46COM 8D 澄清），Gamla Skogsby 位于遗产区内。
tags: 档案, 核验, 厄兰, WHC 968

title_en: The tower at the canal's northern end
notes_en: Desk record, 2026-09-23: the Burning-Lamp Pagoda (first built 557 AD; surviving base Liao-dynasty; body rebuilt 1696 after the 1679 earthquake) is verified as the landmark of the Grand Canal's northern terminus — 'three sights of the tower, and you have reached Tongzhou city'. The Confucian Temple, Youpeng Temple and Ziqing Temple sit in a triangle celebrated as the 'three temples one tower' of Tongzhou. An octagonal thirteen-storey brick pagoda, 56 metres, 2,248 wind bells: read here as a seamark of everyday navigation, not a doctrinal object. Sources: Beijing Municipal Ethnic & Religious Affairs Commission [A]; Beijing Municipal Government [A].
notes_zh: 档案记录 2026-09-23:燃灯塔（始建北周 557 年；现存塔基为辽代；塔身于康熙三十五年 1696 年按原样重建）已核验为大运河北端标志——「三望燃灯塔，便到通州城」。文庙、佑胜教寺与紫清宫呈「品」字形布列,即通州「三庙一塔」。八角十三层密檐砖塔、高 56 米、风铃 2248 枚:此处视为日常航行的航海标,而非教义对象。来源:北京市民宗委 [A]；北京市政府 [A]。
tags: 通州, 燃灯塔, 三庙一塔, 航标, 信仰

title_en: Belief at the endpoint of the Yuan canal
notes_en: Desk record, 2026-09-23: Jishuitan is verified as the Yuan-dynasty terminus where tribute-grain barges laid in, and the Shichahai stretch is State-level protected (7th batch, 2013). Huode Zhenjun Temple and Guanghua Temple are both Beijing municipal protection (3rd batch, 1984). The open question in the field is whether Guanghua's Laba porridge-giving (recorded as late as 2017) still runs today — the 2025 Beijing Daily list did not include it; pending an on-site check. Sources: Beijing Xicheng District Government [A]; Beijing Cultural Heritage Bureau [A].
notes_zh: 档案记录 2026-09-23:积水潭已核验为元代漕运粮船的终点港,什刹海段为全国重点文保（2013 年第七批）。火德真君庙与广化寺均为北京市第三批（1984）市级文保。田野中的悬而未决之间:广化寺的腊八施粥（至迟 2017 年有记录）今日是否仍在进行——2025 年北京日报舍粥名单未见广化寺;待现场复核。来源:北京市西城区政府 [A]；北京市文物局 [A]。
tags: 什刹海, 积水潭, 火德真君庙, 广化寺, 腊八粥, 信仰

notes_en: Desk record, 2026-09-23: Zhangjiawan's place-narrative as a tribute-grain wharf town of mixed beliefs holds only at [C] level at best; no reliable surviving evidence was found for an in-situ Guandi, Dragon-King or River-God temple. Absence of evidence is itself a fieldwork finding: the town's faith-scape must be read today through its breakfast market and the ongoing canal-gateway regeneration rather than through standing shrines. Pending an on-site walking pass (upgrade to walk/ritual).
notes_zh: 档案记录 2026-09-23:张家湾作为「漕运移民市镇、多元信仰」的说法至多停在 [C] 级;就地关帝庙、龙王庙或河神庙,未找到任何可靠的存留证据。缺证本身就是田野结论:此镇的信仰景观如今只能经由它的早市与进行中的运河门户更新被阅读,而非经由站立的香火。待实地行走复核（升级为 walk/ritual）。
tags: 张家湾, 码头市镇, 缺证, 香火, 核验, 信仰

title_en: The sailor's little shrine on the tribute route
notes_en: Desk record, 2026-09-23: Mazu worship moved north along the hereditary sea-canal grain routes — the Yuan court founded Tianhou temples at the Hai-river mouth ('In the third year of Taiding the Heavenly Consort temple was built at Haijin town'); the Qing renamed the goddess Tianhou in 1684; and along the canal her shrines mingled with the lady-detty cults of the north. Read as everyday texture: a votive niche on a grain barge, a safe-passage prayer at a lock — a guardian of movement rather than a sect. Sources: Fang Guangling [B]; Xu Xiaohui [B].
notes_zh: 档案记录 2026-09-23:妈祖信仰随漕运的海陆航路北上——元代于海河口的天津敕建天妃宫（「泰定三年作天妃宫于海津镇」）；清康熙二十三年（1684）改封「天后」；运河沿线的妈祖宫庙又与北方娘娘信仰互渗。读作日常纹理:粮船上的一角神龛、闸前的一次平安祈祷——移动的守护神,而非宗派。来源:方广岭 [B]；徐晓慧 [B]。
tags: 妈祖, 天后, 漕运, 行船人, 神龛, 信仰

title_en: A walking approach to Beijing: the Miaofengshan road
title_zh: 走进北京的香道：妙峰山路
notes_en: Desk record, 2026-09-23: set against the canal's 'see the tower, arrive at the city', the Miaofengshan pilgrimage road is the walking approach to Beijing — tea sheds along the route, incense societies walking the spring and autumn fairs (national intangible heritage, 2008; Gu Jiegang's landmark 1925 survey opens China's folklore fieldwork). Not a canal corridor but a Jifeng road interface: two ways of arriving at the capital, one by boat beneath a tower, one on foot through tea-houses. Pending an on-site walking pass (upgrade to walk/ritual).
notes_zh: 档案记录 2026-09-23:与运河「望塔即到城」相对照,妙峰山香道是「走进北京」的徒步方式——路旁设茶棚,香会按春、秋两香走会（2008 年国家级非遗；顾颉刚 1925 年调查开启中国民俗学首次田野）。非运河廊道,而是京畿行进界面对照:抵达京城的两种方式,一乘舟于塔下,一徒步穿行于茶棚之间。待实地行走复核（升级为 walk/ritual）。
tags: 妙峰山, 香道, 茶棚, 顾颉刚, 抵达方式, 信仰
